title:
CHAIN
OF COMMAND
body:
Move the [character] by 1 space in any direction.

OR

Choose a character with a lower Rank.
Then, Move, Shoot, or Burst using this
Character.
layoutNotes: Portrait-oriented action card with full-bleed sci-fi combat artwork.
The title is centered across two lines in an upper framed panel.
The first effect appears above a centered OR separator.
The second effect has a centered COMMAND heading followed by centered multiline text.
A white human-shaped icon appears inline after “the” in the first effect.
OFFICER appears centered near the bottom.
